# GotQuestions.org

> > GotQuestions.org provides fast, authoritative Bible answers on theology, salvation, Jesus Christ, and Christian doctrine from a Protestant evangelical perspective.

GotQuestions.org is a comprehensive Christian Q&A resource offering articles, FAQs, and topical indexes addressing biblical questions on theology, church doctrine, spiritual guidance, and Christian living. The site features both popular questions and searchable content organized by theme.

## Key Topics

- Bible
- Jesus Christ
- Salvation
- Christian Theology
- Trinity
- Church
- Faith in Christ
- God
- Eternal Life
- Gospel
- Bible Interpretation
- Christian Doctrine
- Spiritual Guidance
- Biblical Canon
- Resurrection

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Bible Questions Answered | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org): GotQuestions.org homepage offering fast Bible Q&A on theology, Jesus, and spiritual guidance.
- [Top 20 Most Frequently Asked Bible Questions | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/top20.html): FAQ listing top 20 Bible questions covering theology, Trinity, and Christian doctrine.
- [Thematic Content Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content.html): Topical directory organizing Bible content by theology, doctrine, and faith topics.
- [Submit your Bible Questions to GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/Bible-Questions.html): Question submission form for contacting Got Questions Ministries with Bible queries.

## Salvation & Christian Life

- [Going to heaven—how can I guarantee my eternal destination? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/going-to-heaven.html): Article on salvation, eternal life, and faith in Jesus Christ for heavenly assurance.
- [How do I get right with God? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/get-right-with-God.html): Guide on salvation, repentance, forgiveness of sin, and relationship with God.
- [What is the purpose of the church? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/purpose-church.html): Article on church purpose, doctrine, fellowship, gospel proclamation, and spiritual growth.

## Biblical History & Interpretation

- [How We Got the Bible — Article Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content_Bible_canon.html): Index on Bible canon, authorship, history, translations, and biblical manuscripts.
- [On what day was Jesus crucified? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/three-days.html): Article on Jesus' crucifixion chronology, resurrection, and gospel accounts.
- [Who were the kings of Israel and Judah? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/kings-Israel-Judah.html): Article on Old Testament kings of Israel and Judah and biblical monarchy history.
- [What did Jesus mean by "upon this rock I will build my church" in Matthew 16:18? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/upon-this-rock.html): Article on Matthew 16:18, Peter's role, church foundation, and theological debate.

## Theology & Doctrine

- [What is dogmatic theology? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/dogmatic-theology.html): Article defining dogmatic theology, divisions of theology, and systematic theology.
- [Questions about Angels and Demons — Theme Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content_angels_demons.html): Theme index on angels, demons, Satan, and spiritual beings in biblical theology.
- [Unsound Prayer — Article Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content_prayer_unsound.html): Article index on unsound prayer practices and biblical critique of Catholic prayer methods.
- [The Occult — Article Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content_cults_religions_occult.html): Article index on occult practices, spiritism, witchcraft from Christian perspective.

## Christian Counseling & Living

- [Counseling Related Questions (All) | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/questions_counseling-related.html): Index on Christian and biblical counseling, mental health, and pastoral care.
- [The Christian and Culture — Article Index | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/content_life_culture.html): Article index on Christian worldview regarding culture, entertainment, and media.

## Optional

- [What's new on GotQuestions.org? | GotQuestions.org](https://www.gotquestions.org/whats-new.html): Index of newest articles on scripture interpretation and biblical passages.
